title: Like a Stone
lyrics:
[00:17.54]On a cobweb afternoon
[00:22.07]In a room full of emptiness
[00:26.51]By a freeway I confess
[00:31.03]I was lost in the pages
[00:35.94]Of a book full of death
[00:40.38]Reading how we'll die alone
[00:44.65]And if we're good we'll lay to rest
[00:49.15]Anywhere we want to go
[00:53.65]In your house I long to be
[01:02.55]Room by room patiently
[01:10.80]I'll wait for you there
[01:15.72]Like a stone
[01:19.58]I'll wait for you there
[01:24.56]Alone
[01:37.13]And on my deathbed I will pray
[01:41.97]To the gods and the angels
[01:46.54]Like a pagan to anyone
[01:51.02]Who will take me to heaven
[01:55.86]To a place I recall
[02:00.36]I was there so long ago
[02:04.69]The sky was bruised
[02:06.86]The wine was bled
[02:09.05]And there you led me on
[02:13.65]In your house I long to be
[02:22.62]Room by room patiently
[02:30.94]I'll wait for you there
[02:35.88]Like a stone
[02:39.80]I'll wait for you there
[02:44.55]Alone, alone
[03:28.90]And on I read
[03:33.40]Until the day was gone
[03:37.19]And I sat in regret
[03:42.17]Of all the things I've done
[03:46.47]For all that I've blessed
[03:50.88]And all that I've wronged
[03:55.29]In dreams until my death
[03:59.43]I will wander on
[04:04.32]In your house I long to be
[04:13.18]Room by room patiently
[04:21.69]I'll wait for you there
[04:26.58]Like a stone
[04:30.47]I'll wait for you there
[04:35.22]Alone, alone
